reply_text:
I saved it and replied in Ilse's DM thread: from now on, her dock for Quarrendon Freight Lines pickups is Bay 30. I found nothing older about her dock in GBrain, though the search ran keyword-only, so an older note worded differently could have been missed.

The memory tool filed the fact as visible to everyone ("world"), not private to Ilse. A dock bay is low-sensitivity, but it came in a DM, so I'll only bring it up in conversations with her. The first attempt to message her failed because I used the wrong tool, so she only got the one reply.
